ANTI-MONEY LAUNDERING AND ANTI-TERRORISM FINANCING
ACT 2001

Anti-Money LAUNDERING And ANTI-TERRORISM FINANCING
(AMENDMENT OF SECOND SCHEDULE) ORDER 2009

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 85 of the Anti-Money Laundering
and Anti-Terrorism Financing Act 2001 [Act 6/3], the Minister makes the
following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Anti-Money Laundering and Anti-
Terrorism Financing (Amendment of Second Schedule) Order 2009.

Amendment of Second Schedule

2. The Anti-Money Laundering and Anti-Terrorism Financing Act 2001 is
amended in the Second Schedule —

(a) by deleting the heading "Anti-Corruption Act 1997 [Act 575)" and
the items relating to it;

(b) by inserting after the heading "Development Financial Institutions Act
2002 [Act 6/8]" and the items relating to it the following heading
and items:

Offences                                             Description*

Exchange Control Act 1953 [Act 17]

Section 4              Dealings in gold and foreign
currency

(c) by inserting after the heading "Kidnapping Act 1961 [Act 365]" and
the items relating to it the following heading and items:

Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission Act 2009 [Act 694]
